title: Unit Event — Grow Glorious Glow — Episode6 Echoes of the Past

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! haven't received any job offers in a while, but one day, an email arrives for Shizuku. It invites her to audition for popular cosmetics brand Grand Fleur's new commercial...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The posing plan for my solo cuts is decided now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I should try seeing how I look.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(No...
The pose itself isn't bad, but my expression of it is too ordinary. I need to achieve a greater presence.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(In order to do that, I have to...
Create some tension.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Like when a needle is pulling on a tight string. A sense of precarious sharpness...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We haven't seen each other since Idol Lovers. It's so nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Also, it's such a relief to see a familiar face.
I was starting to get a little nervous, all on my own.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I completely let my guard down that time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hagiyama was there to compete against me for just one of two spots, but I told her that I was relieved to see her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What I said back there was shameful and disrespectful.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm never going to let myself behave so sloppily ever again.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to start back at square one. I need to feel that desperation again!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Not bad...
But I can still do better.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought she'd take her time getting here today, since she stayed back pretty late last night...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She is setting aside some time here and there to rest, but I'm not sure she's getting enough sleep.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What...?!
Then, Shizuku, you should at least stop and take a drink of water...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She probably can't hear you right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even at school, this is how she's been behaving lately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only has she been laser focused while posing, she's been working out and dieting like nothing else matters.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She seems like a completely different person...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I appeared on this one music program with her, she made this exact expression before taking the stage...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This atmosphere is the same as what I felt back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is the old Shizuku.
The girl walking along the knife's edge... She's beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm gonna run to the store really quick!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku's doing everything she can right now for MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means I should help her come up with meal plans for her diet and stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, I'll go with you.
I know some low-calorie foods that really help you recover after a tough workout.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Keep an eye on Shizuku for us, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing. Good luck, you two!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku's trying to reach a new level right now.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The same way she did back then.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku's pushing herself to the absolute limit like there's no tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And here I am, feeling lucky I get to see her like this.)
